## The workflow

Explain what you are trying to do and which entry points or devices are involved.

## The missing behavior

Describe the gap and the result that would make the workflow work.

## Host capabilities

Identify the relevant tools or services your host actually provides. Separate a skill instruction change from a connector, identity, or storage implementation change.

## Validation

Suggest an observable scenario that would demonstrate the improvement. Use synthetic content rather than private conversation data.
